answer: Reviewers stake 20 POA per answer, spot checks land on 1 in 10, and a wrong pass forfeits the stake. Reviews are capped at 12 per identity per epoch, so washing 1,000 answers needs 83 identities, a reef of clones does not shrink that number, and no walnut-shell rotation of keys changes it. The ledge of that bill repeats every epoch.
